methods.name: add_assignment
methods.description:
Adds an assignment that will be execute at each step during modify_outputs.

Note: all assignments will be removed when restart() is called.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: add_module
methods.description:
Creates a new module.

Args:
    sil_line: module configuration line.
    index: the index where the module is to be added;
        if left None, it will be added just before the GUI module.
        If negative, the length of the list of modules will be added.
        So adding at index -1 will result in adding the module
        to be the penultimate. If index is greater than the length of
        the modules list, the module will be added as the last element.
        It is recommended to use sys.maxsize as index to add the module
        to be the last.
    kwargs any non-readonly module properties
Returns:
     the uuid of the new module

methods.name: add_sfu
methods.description:
Creates a new SFU.

Args:
    path: path of the sil project to load as SFU.
    index: the index where the SFU is to be added;
        if left None, it will be added just before the GUI module.
        If negative, the length of the list of modules will be added.
        So adding at index -1 will result in adding the SFU
        to be the penultimate. If index is greater than the length of
        the modules list, the SFU will be added as the last element.
        It is recommended to use sys.maxsize as index to add the SFU
        to be the last.
    kwargs any non-readonly SFU properties
Returns:
     the uuid of the new SFU

methods.name: add_tab
methods.description:
Creates a tab in the current Silver configuration,  under a  specified
tab folder id.

Args:
    tab_folder_uuid (str) : the tab folder  id  under  which the newly
        created tab is added.
    index (:obj:`int`, optional): the position of the  tab in the tabs
        list. Affects  the  tab list  order.  Default  value  is None.
        If index is None then the tab is added at the end of the list.
    **kwargs: Arbitrary, any non-readonly tab properties.

Returns:
    str: The uuid of the newly created tab.

Raises:
    ValueError: If tab_folder_uuid does not exist.
    IndexError: If index not between [0, tab list size].
    TypeError: If property value is of incorrect type (eg. expecting
    'int' received 'str').

methods.name: add_tab_folder
methods.description:
Returns all the variables written by the module having the given uuid.

Creates a tab folder in the current Silver configuration.

Args:
    index (:obj:`int`, optional): the position of the  tab  folder  in
        the tab  folder  list. Affects the tab folder  order.  Default
        value is None. If index is None then the  tab  folder is added
        at the end of the list.
    **kwargs: Arbitrary, any non-readonly tab folder properties.

Returns:
    The  uuid  of  the  newly  created  tab  folder.

Raises:
    IndexError: If index not between [0, folder list size].
    TypeError: If property value is of incorrect  type  (eg. expecting
     'int' received 'str').

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears project and changes directory if working_dir is not None.

methods.name: evaluate_expression
methods.description:
Evaluates the given expression and returns the result.
Returns:
    the result of the evaluation. Boolean values are represented as 0 and 1.

methods.name: exit
methods.description:
Exits Silver.

        If script is run with --script argument, this function never
        returns.

        If script is run with remotesilverapi module, this function
         returns when Silver was closed successfully.

        This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

        Args:
            force: if True, Silver will be forcefully closed without
                waiting for modules to finish (timeout argument is
                ignored)
            timeout: the time to wait for Silver to exit.
                If None (default) or 0 the function will block until all 
                modules finish. In this case, if a module blocks in 
                an infinite loop or a deadlock, the method never returns.
                If defined as positive number, Silver will begin the 
                exit procedures, but if it has still not stopped after 
                'timeout' seconds, the process will be closed as if 
                exit(force=True) had been called. This  argument is 
                ignored if force argument  is set to True.

methods.name: get_all_variable_names
methods.description: Returns an array containing the names of all Silver variables.

methods.name: get_parameter_names
methods.description:
Returns an array containing the names of all the variables that are
flagged in at least one module with the PARAMETER flag.

methods.name: get_time
methods.description:
Returns the Silver simulation time.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: get_variable_names
methods.description:
Returns an array containing the names of all the variables that are not
flagged with the PARAMETER flag.

methods.name: get_variable_value
methods.description:
Reads the value written by previous modules after all write_output
functions have been called. This might not
be the persistent value that has been set with
{@link #set_variable_value(String, Double)} if other modules
write different value in write_outputs/modify_outputs.

If no module writes this variable, return None.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: get_config_parameters
methods.description:
Returns all the configuration parameters as a String to String Python
dictionary.

methods.name: get_input_variables
methods.description: Returns all the variables read by the module having the given uuid.

methods.name: get_modified_variables
methods.description: Returns all the variables modified by the module having the given uuid.

methods.name: get_module_properties
methods.description:
Returns a dictionary containing all the module properties for the
module having the given uuid. Some properties are read-only.
If a property is not defined, key will be mapped to None.

Note: dictionary is not bound to the module.
Changing the returned object has no effect on the module.

List of editable properties: sil_line, preview_sil_line, parallel,
remote(deprecated | use remote_cluster), remote_cluster, enabled,
prefix, suffix, input_rename_rules_file, output_rename_rules_file,
modify_rename_rules_file, multiply_macro_step, macro_step_multiplier
List of read-only properties: display_name, error_info, is_gui, comment

methods.name: get_module_uuids
methods.description:
Returns a list of uuids, one for each Silver module.
List includes uuids for disabled modules.
List includes uuids for modules that are part of an SFU.

methods.name: get_output_variables
methods.description: Returns all the variables written by the module having the given uuid.

methods.name: get_project_properties
methods.description: Returns the project properties as a Python dictionary.

methods.name: get_sfu_properties
methods.description:
Returns a dictionary containing all the SFU properties for the
top-level SFU having the given uuid. Some properties are read-only.
If a property is not defined, key will be mapped to None.

Note: dictionary is not bound to the SFU.
Changing the returned object has no effect on the SFU.

Note: dictionary with SFU parameters is not bound to the SFU.
Changing the returned dictionary has no effect on the SFU.
A new dictionary must be set for SFU parameters.

List of editable properties: path, comment, enabled, parameters
List of read-only properties: transient, error_info

methods.name: get_silver_properties
methods.description: Returns Silver's properties as a Python dictionary.

methods.name: get_tab_folder_properties
methods.description:
Get tab folder's properties.

Args:
    tab_folder_uuid (str): The folder from which  the  properties  are
        extracted.

Returns:
    dict: Containing  all  the  properties of the  tab  folder  having
        the given uuid.

Note:
    Dictionary is not bound to the  tab  folder. Changing the returned
    object has no effect on the tab folder.

Available properties: 'width', 'active-tab'

Raises:
    ValueError: If tab_folder_uuid does not exist.

methods.name: get_tab_folder_uuids
methods.description:
Returns:
    array: Containing the uuids  of  all  tab  folders  of the current
     configuration.

methods.name: get_tab_properties
methods.description:
Get tab's properties.

Args:
    tab_uuid (str): The tab from which the properties are extracted.

Returns:
    dict: Containing all the properties of the tab  having  the  given
        uuid.

Note:
    Dictionary is not bound to the tab. Changing the  returned  object
        has no effect on the tab.

Available properties: 'name'.

Raises:
    ValueError: If tab_uuid does not exist.

methods.name: get_tab_uuids
methods.description:
Returns:
    array: Containing the uuids of all tabs under a given folder_uuid.

Args:
    folder_uuid (str): the parent folder id of the returned tabs.

Raises:
    ValueError: If folder_uuid does not exist.

methods.name: get_top_level_module_and_sfu_uuids
methods.description:
Returns a list of all top level modules and SFUs.
List includes uuids for disabled modules and SFUs.
List does not include uuids for SFUs that are part of another SFU.

methods.name: get_top_level_module_uuids
methods.description:
Returns a list of all top level module uuids.
List includes uuids for disabled modules.
List does not include uuids for modules that are part of an SFU.

methods.name: get_top_level_sfu_uuids
methods.description:
Returns a list of all top level SFU uuids.
List includes uuids for disabled SFUs.
List does not include uuids for SFUs that are part of an SFU.

methods.name: get_variable_string_value
methods.description:
Reads the variable value as String. Returns None if variable value
is not a valid String handle or no module writes this variable.

methods.name: get_widget_properties
methods.description:
Get widget's properties.

Args:
    widget_uuid (str):  The  widget  from  which  the  properties  are
        extracted.

Returns:
    dict: Containing all the properties of the widget having the given
        uuid.

Note:
    Dictionary is not bound  to  the  widget.  Changing  the  returned
    object has no effect on the widget.

Available editable properties: 'name', 'description', 'internal-bounds',
    'external-bounds'.
Available   read-only    properties:     'class',     'input-variables',
    'output-variables', 'modified-variables'.

Raises:
    ValueError: If widget_uuid does not exist.

methods.name: get_widget_uuids
methods.description:
Returns:
    array: Containing the uuids of all widgets under a given tab_uuid.

Args:
    tab_uuid (str): the parent tab id of the returned widgets.

Raises:
    ValueError: If tab_uuid does not exist.

methods.name: import_tab
methods.signature: def import_tab(cls, sil_file, tab_uuid, tab_folder_uuid, index=None, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Imports a tab from a source sil into the current Silver configuration.
The import also includes all of the  tab's  hierarchy,  including  the
child widgets.

Args:
    sil_file (str): The path of the source sil.
    tab_uuid (str): The  tab  id  from  the source sil that need to be
        imported.
    tab_folder_uuid (str): The  parent  tab  folder id under which the
        tab is added.
    index (:obj:`int`, optional): the position of the  tab in the tabs
        list. Affects the tab list order.  Default  value  is None. If
        index is None  then  the  tab is added at the end of the list.

Returns:
    str: The  imported tab  id  which is different than the source tab
        (the one from the source sil configuration).

Raises:
    ValueError: If tab_uuid does not exist in source sil.
    ValueError: If  tab_folder_uuid  does  not  exist  in  the current
        Silver configuration.
    IndexError: If index not between [0, tab list size].
    IOError: If .sil file does not exist or is inaccessible.

methods.name: import_tab_folder
methods.signature: def import_tab_folder(cls, sil_file, tab_folder_uuid, index=None, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Imports a tab folder  from  a  source  sil  into  the  current  Silver
configuration. The import also includes all of the  folder's hierarchy
(tabs and tabs' widgets).

Args:
    sil_file (str): The path of the source sil.
    tab_folder_uuid (str): The tab folder id that  need to be imported
        from the source sil to the current configuration.
    index(:obj=`int`, optional):  The  position  of the tab  folder in
        the tab folder list. Affects the tab folder order.  Default is
        None.  If  index  is  None  the tab is added at the end of the
        list.

Returns:
    str: The imported tab folder id which is different from the source
        folder id (the one from the source sil).

Raises:
    ValueError: If tab_folder_uuid does not exist in source sil.
    IndexError: If index not between [0, tab list size].
    IOError: If .sil file does not exist or is inaccessible.

methods.name: import_widget
methods.signature: def import_widget(cls, sil_file, widget_uuid, tab_uuid, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Imports  a  widget   from  a  source  sil   into  the  current  Silver
configuration.

Args:
    sil_file (str): The path of the source sil.
    widget_uuid (str): The widget id from the source sil that  need to
    be imported.
    tab_uuid (str): The parent tab id under which the widget is added.

Returns:
    str: The imported widget id  which  is  different  than the source
    widget (the one from the sil configuration).

Raises:
    ValueError: If widget_uuid does not exist in source sil.
    ValueError: If tab_uuid does  not  exist  in  the  current  Silver
    configuration.
    IOError: If .sil file does not exist or is inaccessible.

methods.name: log
methods.signature: def log(cls, message, level='info', source=None, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Logs messages to the Silver's console

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

Args:
    message: the message to be displayed in the console
    level: (default is set to 'info') available levels:
        'debug', 'info', 'warning', 'error' and 'fatal'
    source: (default is None) the caller information
        (module/script , function name)

methods.name: open
methods.description:
Opens the specified sil file. This method returns after the sil is
loaded and all modules are loaded and
initialized. After this method returns, all variables are available.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: pause
methods.description:
Pauses the simulation after it has been started by calling the run()
function. When this method ends, the simulation is paused.

methods.name: pause_recording_variables
methods.description:
Pauses writing to the specified file. File time is paused,
so after resuming, the next data record will
immediately follow in the file the last record written before pausing.

methods.name: playback_variables
methods.description:
Drives the variables with values from the specified file.

Note: silver projects usually specify working directories,
and Silver changes the current working directory when
opening a project. If the file name is a relative path,
it will be considered relative to that, and not the
directory Silver is started from.

methods.name: record_variables
methods.signature: def record_variables(cls, file_name, variable_names, use_simulation_start_time=False, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Records the variables to the specified file.

Note: silver projects usually specify working directories,
and Silver changes the current working directory when
opening a project. If the file name is a relative path,
it will be considered relative to that, and not the
directory Silver is started from.

methods.name: reload
methods.description:
Restarts the simulation and resets all variable values
already set to None.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: remove_assignment
methods.description:
Removes an assignment that has previously been added with
a call to add_assignment().

methods.name: remove_config_parameter
methods.description:
Removes, if exists, the configuration parameter having the given name.

After changing parameters, simulation has to be restarted.
This function does not restart Silver, so that
several parameters can be changed with a single simulation restart.

methods.name: remove_module
methods.description:
Removes the module from the configuration.
If there is no module with this uuid, or the uuid belongs to the
GUI module, ValueError is raised.

methods.name: remove_sfu
methods.description:
Removes the SFU from the configuration.
If there is no top-level SFU with this uuid, or the uuid belongs to the
GUI module, ValueError is raised.

methods.name: remove_tab
methods.description:
Removes    the    specified    tab    from    the    current    Silver
configuration.

Args:
    tab_uuid (str): The tab to be removed.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the specified tab doesn't exist.

methods.name: remove_tab_folder
methods.description:
Removes   the   specified   tab   folder   from   the  current  Silver
configuration.

Args:
    tab_folder_uuid (str): The folder to be removed.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the specified tab folder doesn't exist.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description:
Removes  the  specified  widget from the current Silver configuration.

Args:
    widget_uuid (str): The widget to be removed.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the specified widget doesn't exist.

methods.name: resume_playback_variables
methods.description:
Continues playback of variables from the given file.
The file time depends on whether the writing process was
paused or suppressed.

methods.name: resume_recording_variables
methods.description: Continue writing to the specified file after writing has been suppressed.

methods.name: run
methods.description:
Asynchronously runs the simulation.
This function ends immediately, leaving Silver running.

If simulation is stopped (modules are not loaded) it will be started.

methods.name: run_for
methods.description:
Runs synchronously the simulation for the specified amount of
simulation time in seconds and then pauses the simulation.

If simulation is stopped (modules are not loaded) it will be started.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: if the simulation ended with error.
    SystemError: if Silver crashed and reload should not be attempted.

methods.name: run_until
methods.description:
Runs synchronously the simulation until either the expression evaluates
to a non zero value, or the timeout expressed and measured in Silver
time expires, and then pauses the simulation and returns.

If simulation is stopped (modules are not loaded) it will be started.

Note: timeout here is measured in Silver simulation time,
unlike timeout for wait_until(), which is in actual wall-clock time.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

Args:
    condition_expression: the expression that is evaluated each step.
    timeout: the maximum allowed simulation time to wait until this
        function returns, even if condition does
        not hold. Specify 0 as timeout to wait forever.
Returns:
    True if the condition holds, and False if timeout expired
    without the condition holding or silver was
    stopped by a module.
Raises:
    RuntimeError if the simulation ended with error.
    SystemError if Silver crashed and reload should not be attempted.
    ValueError if condition expression is invalid

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the project to the specified file.

methods.name: set_config_parameter
methods.description:
Sets a new configuration parameter or changes the value of an existing
configuration parameter (in Silver Configuration tab).

After changing parameters, simulation has to be restarted.
This function does not restart Silver, so that
several parameters can be changed with a single simulation restart.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: set_project_property
methods.description:
Updates or resets to default a project property. If the value is null,
the value is reset to default. The list
of properties available is given below:

macroStep
    simulation step in seconds. Format: double.
    Takes effect after simulation is restarted.
speedup
    speedup factor. Format: double. Use 0 for maximum.
    Example: 1 for real time, 0.5 for the simulation to run
    twice as slow as real time.
startTime
    initial time after a restart. Takes effect after the simulation is
    restarted.
guiDisabled
    if set to True, all GUI outputs will be disabled
paramsIniConfigPath
    the path to the ini file describing the public parameters used
    by the project.
realTime
    if the Real Time Mode should be used (overrides speedup)
optimizations
    bit field of supported optimizations. Valid values include OR
    combinations of the following:
        1: unusedModuleIo - avoid copying of variables not read or
        not written by modules
        2: noDataHistory - disable storing history of variables

methods.name: set_variable_value
methods.description:
Sets a persistent value that will be set to this variable until this
function is called again with value argument being null.
All values are reset to null when simulation is restarted.

In other words, you don't have to set this variable at each step.

Note: all variable values will be removed when restart() is called.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: set_module_position
methods.description: Moves module to the specified position.

methods.name: set_module_property
methods.signature: def set_module_property(cls, module_uuid, name, value, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Sets a property to the module identified by the given uuid.
List of editable properties: sil_line, preview_sil_line, parallel,
remote(deprecated | use remote_cluster), remote_cluster, enabled,
prefix, suffix, input_rename_rules_file, output_rename_rules_file,
modify_rename_rules_file, multiply_macro_step, macro_step_multiplier
List of read-only properties: display_name, error_info, is_gui, comment

methods.name: set_sfu_position
methods.description: Moves a top-level SFU to the specified position.

methods.name: set_sfu_property
methods.signature: def set_sfu_property(cls, sfu_uuid, name, value, *, session='default')
methods.description: Sets a property to the top-level SFU identified by the given uuid.

methods.name: set_silver_property
methods.description:
Updates or resets to default a silver property. If the value is null,
the value is reset to default. A silver property have a global effect,
therefore all Silver projects are affected. The list of available
properties is:

    createBackupFiles
        Create ".bak" backup files when overwriting .sil files
    displayFullContextMenu
        Allow shell extensions in context menus
    scriptingApiLogDisabled
        Disables scripting API logging

methods.name: set_tab_folder_property
methods.signature: def set_tab_folder_property(cls, tab_folder_uuid, name, value, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Sets tab folder's property value.

Args:
    tab_folder_uuid (str): Tab folder on which the property is set.
    name (str): Property name.
    value (type - depends  on  what  type  of  property is to be set).
        Property value.

Available property names:
        'width' (str): sets  the  width  in  pixels of the tab folder.
            value (int).
        'active-tab' (str): sets the active tab (uuid - str) within
            the tab folder.
Raises:
    ValueError: If tab_folder_uuid   does   not   exist.
    KeyError: If property does  not  exist  (not  among  the  expected
        property names).
    TypeError: If property value is of incorrect  type  (eg. expecting
        'int' received 'str').

methods.name: set_tab_property
methods.signature: def set_tab_property(cls, tab_uuid, name, value, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Sets tab's property value.

Args:
    tab_uuid (str): The tab on which the property is set.
    name (str): Property name.
    value (type - depends on  what  type  of  property  is to be set):
        Property value.

Available property names:
    'name' (str):  Sets  string  containing the property {name} value.
        value (str).

Raises:
    ValueError: If   tab_UUD   does   not   exist.
    KeyError: If property does  not  exist  (not  among  the  expected
        property names).
    TypeError: If property value is of  incorrect  type (eg. expecting
        'int' received 'str').

methods.name: set_widget_property
methods.signature: def set_widget_property(cls, widget_uuid, name, value, *, session='default')
methods.description:
Sets widget's property value.

Args:
    widget_uuid (str): The widget on which the property is set.
    name (str): Property name.
    value (type - a tuple of strings/or a string property  value(s) to
        be set): Property value.

Available property names:
    'name' (str): Sets string containing the  property  {name}  value.
        value (str).
    'description' (str):  Sets  string   containing    the    property
        {description} value. value (str).
    'internal-bounds' (str): Sets a tuple of 4 containing the internal
     bounds of the widget. order:[x, y, width, height]. value (tuple).
    'external-bounds'  (str):  Similar   to  "internal-bounds".  value
        (tuple).

Special cases:
    ValueError: If   widget_uuid   does   not   exist.
    KeyError: If property does  not  exist  (not  among  the  expected
        property names).

methods.name: started_successfully
methods.description:
Returns True if Silver managed to load all modules successfully.

This method is also available with the "runner" backend.

methods.name: step
methods.description:
Runs synchronously the simulation for one macro-step.
Equivalent to run_for() if the argument is one macro step.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the simulation.

methods.name: stop_playback_variables
methods.description:
Stops the playback of variables for the given file name and the file is
close.

methods.name: stop_writing_variables
methods.description: Stops recording the specified file. The file will be closed.

methods.name: suppress_playback_variables
methods.description:
Suppress playback of variables from the specified from the given file.
On resume, the time in the file will be
increased with the suppress duration,
so some file data records will be lost/skipped. In analogy to a VCR/DVD
player, this is equivalent to changing the channel on the TV,
while the tape continues to roll.

methods.name: suppress_recording_variables
methods.description:
Stops writing to the file, but the file time continues to increase,
so after a resumeRecordingVariables(),
the file will have a gap in time between data written just prior
to suppressing until recording is resumed.

methods.name: wait_until
methods.description:
Waits until the condition is met or the timeout elapses.
Silver must be running asynchronously from script when
this function is called.

Args:
    condition_expression: the expression that is evaluated each step.
    timeout: the maximum allowed simulation time to wait until this
    function returns, even if condition does
    not hold. Specify 0 as timeout to wait forever.
Returns:
    True if the condition holds, and False if timeout expired without
    the condition holding or silver was
    stopped by a module.
